chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, who said:
I performed wudu (ablution) but did not wash my penis, then I performed salat (prayer). So I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about that, and he said: Wash your penis and repeat your salat (prayer).

key_terms.أَغْسِلْ: to wash as an act of ritual purification

ai.seo_question: If someone performs wudu (ablution) but does not wash the penis before salat (prayer), must the prayer be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning taharah and salat (prayer). It indicates that if one performs wudu (ablution) and prays without washing the penis after impurity, he must wash it and repeat the prayer.
